orders_scope: Batch 6 low-k short starts; both (x,y) and (y,x)+[15,15] finishes on rows needing SAC, with prescribed caps. The selected ac-00037 first probe is a separate offline AC-only row at start length 31, one beyond the original <=30 slice.

archived_method.method: Exact capped BFS on ordered freely reduced rank-2 relator pairs. Sorted disk layers with same/previous-layer subtraction; row frontier meets a closed goal component under the same total-length cap. Reverse the goal-side moves by the official inverse map and independently replay the complete route.
archived_method.original_success_and_negatives: The checkpoint and ledgers contain scoped closed/maxlayer negatives; no prior Charlie ac-00037 cap result was found. Large frontier data were not present and are not claimed reproduced.

new_lane.representation: exact ordered tuple pair, freely reduced by pinned official core.apply_move; no cyclic rotation, relator permutation, or generator relabeling quotient
new_lane.caps: default start+8,+10,+12; ascending cap ladder advances only after a complete component closure
new_lane.goal_ball: bounded radius 5 generated within each total-length cap, then exact row-side BFS; first collision reconstructs a verified route
new_lane.budget: one shared 180-second/600000-admitted-record/1024-MiB budget, with explicit partial layers
new_lane.negative_scope: A stopped partial layer cannot prove a cap empty; coverage gives completed depths only. Closure of a full start component does prove no route under that cap. A fully constructed goal ball plus complete start layers can exclude only the stated finite move-depth and cap.
new_lane.startup: Enforce deadline/node/address limits; load and check all official checker pins; allow absent saved baseline using exact official start.

separate_search_family: Earlier ac-00037 route-union bridge had 600000 records and no <=31 route; this cap-ladder searches original state neighborhoods, not route-local bridge seeds.
first_probe: runs/charlie_revival/coverage.json: radius 7 spent 599999 of 600000 records on an incomplete goal depth-6 layer, leaving only the start root; allocation failure, no mathematical negative.
repaired_probe: runs/charlie_revival/repaired_run/coverage.json: radius 5 completed the goal ball and searched the start frontier through complete expansion depth 10 before node cap in depth 11. Cap 39 remained incomplete.
